sequential_dependency.intermediate: The constructed spiral grid together with its terminal coordinate and the deterministic shortest open-cell route from entrance (1,0) to an open terminal neighbor.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Construct the exact clockwise green spiral for the input dimensions and expose its terminal cell and open-corridor geometry.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Consume that spiral as the walkability map, run right/down/left/up breadth-first search through zero cells, and paint the recovered route blue while retaining the green walls.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B reads both legal neighbors and terminal-adjacent goals from A’s spiral. Replacing the walkability intermediate with a blank canvas permits the route to cross cells that A made green, so the final grid changes.
